arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import parse
# Test R1: trailing newline
r = parse.parse('hello {}', 'hello world\n')
print('R1 trailing newline:', r)

# Test R2: numeric indices
try:
    r = parse.parse('{0}', 'hello')
    print('R2 {0}:', r)
except Exception as e:
    print('R2 {0} error:', e)

try:
    r = parse.parse('{0:d}', '42')
    print('R2 {0:d}:', r)
except Exception as e:
    print('R2 {0:d} error:', e)

# Test R6: format property
p = parse.compile('hello {}')
print('R6 format property:', hasattr(p, 'format'), getattr(p, 'format', None))
"
